theme_and_tone.vibe: Premium, authoritative yet supportive, clinical diagnosis meets modern design studio.
theme_and_tone.target_audience: Stressed French-speaking job candidate, 50% mobile (must work flawlessly at 375px).
theme_and_tone.design_archetype: Organic & Earthy blended with Swiss & High-Contrast (for metrics). Focus on building trust and triggering a 'wow' moment upon payment.

headings.rules: Used for all headings. H1 must not exceed text-5xl on mobile, text-6xl on desktop. Tight tracking (`tracking-tight`).

body.rules: Used for all body text, paragraphs, labels, and form inputs. Left-aligned for readability.

data.rules: Used EXCLUSIVELY for data, numbers, scores, and tabular-nums. Gives a clinical, precise feel.

colors.rules: Use the light beige/cream for main backgrounds. Use soft glow halos for cards (`shadow-[0_0_40px_-10px_rgba(112,83,205,0.1)]`). Primary actions MUST be cyan. Accent texts on light backgrounds MUST be dark amber. Score rings and brand elements use the violet.

global.spacing: Generous spacing. Use `py-20` to `py-32` for sections. Mobile-first padding.
global.breadcrumb: Thin progress bar indicating steps: 1 Analyser → 2 Comprendre → 3 Choisir → 4 Télécharger.

direction_a.name: Diagnostic clinique
direction_a.description: Report reads like a health checkup.
direction_a.structure: Verdict band with XL score ring + diagnostic sentence. 'Preuves' section: 2x2 grid of compact gauge cards. 'Ordonnance' section: 3 numbered priority actions. Avant/Après CV card with blurred teaser for free users.

direction_b.name: Studio progressif
direction_b.structure: Desktop: Left (60%) is live A4 preview of optimized CV teaser cropped at 60% with discreet diagonal watermark. Right (40%) is compact diagnostic with score + top 3 gaps + missing keyword chips. Mobile: Becomes tabs 'Diagnostic | Mon CV'. Payment unlocks in place with 600ms unblur transition.

cv_gallery.structure: 6-column grid (on large screens, fewer on mobile). Cards contain A4 ratio thumbnails using CSS zoom (no `transform: scale`). 6 templates named: paris, london, tokyo, stockholm, berlin, milan. Round checkmarks for selection. Sticky header with ONE primary CTA ('Télécharger le PDF').

components.ScoreRing: Circular SVG progress indicator using violet and gray, with JetBrains Mono number in the center.
components.KeywordChip: Pill-shaped tag (`rounded-full px-3 py-1`), using dark amber for missing keywords or cyan for matched.
components.Cards: Soft glow halo. White background (`bg-white`), `rounded-2xl`, subtle border `border-black/5`, and the specific violet shadow.
components.A4Preview: A CSS-based A4 container with ratio 210/297. For thumbnails, use `zoom` property, NOT scale, to maintain text legibility logic. The free version must use skeleton bars (no real text) and a watermark overlay.
components.PremiumTeaser: Content obscured by `blur-md`. Has an unlock overlay with a CTA. On unlock, animate `backdrop-filter` from blur to none over 600ms.
components.Forms: Use customized Shadcn UI elements for drag-drop PDF/DOCX or text paste, job offer field, target role, and consent checkbox.
components.Marquee: Slow editorial marquee for social proof. Use `react-fast-marquee` or Framer Motion.

motion.hero: Line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion (`staggerChildren`). Subtle parallax on scroll.
motion.scroll: Staggered scroll reveals for 'how it works' and features.

image_urls.description: Stressed professional working on laptop, useful for hero or problem statement section.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup standard React/FastAPI workspace structure, install `framer-motion`, `lucide-react`, and configure Tailwind config with brand colors and fonts.
2. Implement a global sticky header (nav) and a thin progress bar component (Breadcrumb: Analyser -> Comprendre -> Choisir -> Télécharger).
3. Build the `/ats` Landing Page: Hero with line-by-line text reveal, drag-drop form (mocked), job offer field, consent, social proof marquee, 'how it works', and FAQ.
4. Build `/audit-a` (Direction A): Clinical diagnostic view. Verdict band, 2x2 compact gauge cards, 3 numbered actions, avant/après blurred CV card.
5. Build `/audit-b` (Direction B): Split-view 40/60 layout. Left side A4 preview (cropped at 60% with diagonal watermark). Right side compact diagnostic + keyword chips. Implement mobile tabs.
6. Build `/cv` Gallery Page: 6 templates (CSS-styled A4 mockups using the names: paris, london, tokyo, stockholm, berlin, milan). Thumbnails use CSS zoom. Sticky CTA to download.
7. Ensure the 600ms unblur 'wow' moment is implemented as a toggleable state for demonstration (Free vs Premium states).
9. Provide toggle links/buttons between Direction A and Direction B in the UI for easy comparison.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and the specified violet soft glow.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. No `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Use modern pill-shaped or sharp buttons with hover animations.
NEVER use emoji characters for icons. Use `lucide-react`.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
NEVER use placeholder text for images. Use the provided image_urls or CSS patterns.
